caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of geometric and stylized elements set on a textured beige background. At the top, there is a cross with flared ends outlined in dark red, filled with gold, and decorated with blue inner patterns and radiating yellow lines behind it. Below the cross is a bow-like shape with four petal-like loops outlined in blue, filled with gold and detailed with red and blue patterns, and a circular knot at the center where the loops meet. On either side behind the bow are two stylized yellow leaf or wing shapes with dark red tips. At the center-bottom of the composition is a large, circular mandala-like design. This circular element is bordered in dark red and blue and contains concentric patterns of petal and triangular shapes in yellow, blue, and red, radiating outward from a central blue dot. The overall composition uses a limited palette of gold, red, blue, and beige.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
